novelty.justification: The claim predicts that "the self-knowledge probe reads 'unknown' equally in both modes" while recognition "is decoupled from it in the spontaneous mode," making its novelty route a mode-dependent causal mechanism rather than merely a new hallucination benchmark. Searches around "LLM direct query versus free generation hallucination," "spontaneous versus provoked confabulation LLM," "unknown entity recognition direction refusal gating," and "latent uncertainty signal open-ended generation" found the closest behavioral work in Multi-model assurance analysis showing large language models are highly vulnerable to adversarial hallucination attacks during clinical decision support (2025), which studies elaboration of prompt-injected false details, while entity-awareness and internal-state hallucination work studies recognition primarily under elicited answering. Moving from those lines of work to a same-entity dissociation where the unknown signal remains present but loses causal coupling to attribute extraction requires a new core relationship, not a direct transfer, although it remains within established probing and activation-patching frameworks rather than introducing a new interpretability paradigm.
